authority: PI, 2026-09-04, before any DLD result exists: keep the frozen spec as-is, but fix the NAME of the agreement arm and state precisely what a large mismatch-vs-agreement gap is and is not allowed to mean.
rule: APPEND, not an edit. No sampling rule, seed, horizon, quantity or procedure changes. Naming and permitted inference only.

NAMING.why: a control implies a matched counterfactual. The two arms perturb by different KINDS of alternative: at mismatch states the comparison is a_student vs a_teacher, both drawn from competent policies; at agreement states it is a_shared vs a_runner-up, where the alternative is merely a plausible legal action. Calling the second a control would invite reading the gap as a clean between-state comparison, which it is not.
NAMING.for_the_writeup: use decision-sensitivity reference / local perturbation baseline in any paper text, table header, or figure caption.

WHAT_A_LARGE_GAP_MAY_MEAN: mismatch decisions occur at states where swapping between two COMPETENT strategies has unusually large downstream consequences, relative to a baseline measuring ordinary local decision sensitivity.
WHAT_A_LARGE_GAP_MAY_NOT_MEAN: 'mismatch states are more important than agreement states'. The perturbations differ in quality, so part of any gap is attributable to teacher-quality substitution rather than to the states themselves being more pivotal. This limitation was identified before results and is not to be quietly dropped once numbers exist.
STILL_USEFUL_BECAUSE: the licensed reading answers the mechanistic question the average-agreement statistic cannot touch: whether ~2-3% residual action mismatch can coexist with a large loss in payoff crossover because the mismatches land where competent-strategy choice actually swings outcomes.

IF_IT_FIRES_STRONGLY.tightening_is_a_separate_experiment: a better-matched comparison -- e.g. matching branch points on the student's action-confidence gap, or perturbing each policy to its OWN runner-up symmetrically -- would be a SEPARATE preregistered diagnostic with its own frozen spec and its own fresh seed block.
IF_IT_FIRES_STRONGLY.explicitly_not: a midstream patch to DECISION_LEVERAGE_DIAGNOSTIC_SPEC.json or a re-run of its block after seeing its result.

SUPPORTING_OBSERVATION_FROM_OTD_ROUND_1: the covariate-shift picture keeps weakening as round-1 training proceeds: at epoch 5, student-state holdout agreement 0.975/0.990 against teacher-state holdout 0.968/0.990. The student's own visited states are not a hidden region where imitation falls apart -- they are marginally easier. Scope caveat from ONPOLICY_TD_FALSIFICATION_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.json still applies: these are CPU-generated states, and DLD is run on CUDA precisely to close that gap.
